description: Defines the SDT class for DVB service description tables, including nested ServiceIterator class, constants, and methods for parsing and iterating over DVB SDT data.

classes.name: SDT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Service Description Table with methods to access transport stream info and iterate over services.

classes.name: SDT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class to traverse services within an SDT, providing access to service details and descriptors.

methods.name: SDT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the SDT object contains valid data.

methods.name: SDT::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the SDT data.

methods.name: SDT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the services listed in the SDT.
